spans.s: Argala.--The word which is usual later to denote the wooden pin of a door is found in the Śāṇkhāyana Āraṇyaka (ii. 16) in the compound argaleṣīke to denote the pin and bar of the door of a cow-pen. Cf. iṣīkā.

Argala-Kāhoḍi is mentioned in the kāṭhaka Samhitā (xxv. 7) as a teacher. The name may, however, be aryala, as suggested in the St. Petersburg Dictionary, s.v., and as read by v. Schroeder in his edition. The Kapiṣṭhala (xxxix. 5) has Ayala. See below.
